description: Reshape the selected output to 9:16, 16:9, 1:1 or 4:5. subject follows the subject; contain keeps the whole picture with bars; cover fills with optional x/y. add true creates another output and preserves this one. frame null restores the original shape. Crop only when requested. Read get_project_context first and pass its base_version and selected output_id. Saves a playable project; request a file separately with check_video with_download. Unsupported changes refuse without rebuilding. Preserve operation_id and exact inputs on retries. Uses the account's direct-edit allowance. Cost: Free: no credits.

base_version.description: The version the edits are for; the current one when left out.

operation_id.description: A stable ID for this request. Preserve it on retries. Use a new ID only for a deliberate new request.

output_id.description: One output (a hook, a Short, a format) from check_video; the main film when left out.
